Flowchart Describing the Computational Screening of Cathode-Coating Materials Following the initial screening, phase stability, electrochemical stability, and chemical stability were used as sequential ﬁlters for the high-throughput screening. Eg is the density functional theory (DFT)-calculated Kohn-Sham band gap; Vred and Vox are the reduction and oxidation limits of the electrochemical stability window in V versus Li metal, respectively; DErxt is the reaction energy of the material with the cathode or electrolyte in eV/atom; LPS denotes the SSE material Li3PS4; and NCM denotes the fully lithiated cathode material LiNi1/3Co1/3Mn1/3O2.

Shortcomings of the study.—In this study, we simulated only in two dimensions. In Fig. 4 in Results, it was demonstrated that a 2D cluster DEM model may overestimate the solid fraction at low fabrication pressure. This may also affect the contact area between the particles. Even though our simulations were conducted in 2D, we assumed the domain to have a thickness in the z-direction for the purpose of contact area estimation and volume fractions. The shape of the particles was assumed to be spherical which simpliﬁed the calculations considerably.
